in_marathi.name: Shailee
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shailee हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shaila', meaning 'mountain'. In Hindu mythology, Shailee is a name associated with the goddess Parvati, who is known for her radiant beauty and grace. The name symbolizes the inner light and strength that shines within every individual.
